elaine: dropped a compact "mini-timeline" mock for the Deployments panel. goal: make canary adjustments and A/B switches discoverable without crowding the UI. figma: https://figma.redwood/mini-tl/08 samir: looks clean. question: for A/B tests should we show both variants inline or toggle a variant view? inline is transparent but can be visually noisy for big histories. li: prefer inline summary rows per variant with a chevron to expand details. show tiny % pill and a short label 'A / B'. keyboard users can toggle with Enter; use aria-expanded on the chevron button. noah: copy nit: variant label -> 'Variant A (control)' / 'Variant B (experiment)'. also microcopy under chevron: 'Switch traffic' / 'View diff'. keep it short. anya: accessibility: when chevron expands, move focus into the expanded panel and announce via aria-live: 'Expanded variant details for vX.Y'. avoid hover-only behavior. also ensure pills meet 4.5:1 contrast. elaine: rollback placement discussion: inline quick-rollback icon vs drawer confirm. leaning to hidden inline icon for staging, drawer-confirm for prod. protects against misclicks. thoughts? samir: agree. inline for staging only. for prod show a small disabled inline icon with tooltip "Rollback requires confirmation" and accessible description via aria-describedby. li: confirm modal pattern: role="alertdialog", aria-labelledby + typed confirmation for prod (type 'ROLLBACK'). focus on the input when opened. provide 'View audit trail' link in footer. noah: keyboard shortcuts idea: allow left/right to move between timeline clusters, J/K to move rows, and Shift+R to start rollback (modal). shortcuts are opt-in and documented in Help. anya: paste for handoff: ```html

Variant details for vX.Y

Opened variant details. Press Esc to close.
``` a11y-bot: created task #5432 "mini-timeline-variants-a11y". reminders set. :white_check_mark: elaine: action items: samir update variant row copy + em-dash separators, li add aria-expanded sample and focus notes, anya check pill contrast and add handoff snippets, noah wire shortcuts doc. aiming for dev FF next week. thanks all :sparkles:
